casual3.scene: She rests during an opera-house costume event in a red velvet chair in the grand lobby beside its gilded staircase, with a folding fan held at chest height. Marble pillars and red curtains fill the wide setting.
casual3.outfit: An opaque black-and-white maid-inspired event dress with a fitted apron, short cropped skirt, and small side waist cutouts; secure coverage at chest and hips, white ankle socks and black Mary Jane shoes.
casual3.custom: A small blue feather brooch fastens the apron bib; her left hand rests on her lap and the right hand holds the fan at its base.
